name: Cursor Automations
desc: Always-on Cursor agents that wake on a schedule or an event.
desc_zh: 按时间表或事件触发、常驻运行的 Cursor 智能体。
solves: Recurring chores wait until someone remembers them; the trigger fires the agent and it works in its own cloud sandbox.
solves_zh: 重复性杂务总要等有人想起来才做；触发器一响，智能体就在自己的云端沙箱里开工。
best_for: You want dependency bumps merged every Monday morning without opening the editor.
best_for_zh: 想让依赖升级每周一早上自动合掉，不用自己开编辑器。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — cursor.com/changelog directory）。 Named in-product capability with its own docs section, distinct from Cursor background agents already in the ledger. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「Automations」，加上产品名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://cursor.com/changelog/03-05-26
